title: A sleep diary between shifts
description: Count daytime sleep and several stretches of rest, and see the history alongside the work schedule.

blocks.text: A person sleeps in the day after a night shift, or in several stretches across a day. A log built only around an ordinary night distorts their history before any scoring even starts.

quote.text: It gives terrible ratings to folks if they do not sleep in certain times (which you cannot set). Due to work schedules, people sleep at different times. For example, a night shift worker would sleep during the day but you cannot put that in the app

blocks.text: Allow an arbitrary start and end for a stretch, several entries in a day, and manual edits that stay visible. Rest can be lined up with shifts without assigning every episode an artificial “night”.

Test the transitions across midnight and a run of several shifts. Boundaries obtained automatically and the owner’s own correction have to be distinguishable. The first result is a history you can follow, not a promise to undo the consequences of a non-standard schedule.
